text: A follow-up study revisited the g-C3N4 / Rhodamine B system and reported removal performance as a dimensionless fraction instead of a percentage.
The RhB initial concentration was 10 mg/L and the catalyst dosage was 500 mg/L, irradiated with a 150 W LED source. The removal efficiency reached 0.92 after 120 min of reaction.
The fraction removed, 1 - Ct/C0, was obtained from absorbance readings at 554 nm on the same UV-Vis instrument as in the earlier work.
